summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.1 - CLOFAB ## Introduction to CloFab This video is for you to introduce CloFab. The CloFab function can make it easy for you to create high-quality digital fabrics and apply them to 3D clothing immediately to check the effect. Before that, you must use a seamless fabric generator to create a pattern and a fabric generator to create physical properties. Starting from the 2025.1 version, you can use these two functions seamlessly in CloFab. In addition, using the CloZFab fabric measurement kit—a new solution based on Clo's latest AI technology—you can more accurately and faster digitalize the fabric. The CloZFab fabric measurement kit is a product designed for face-to-face corporate customer sales. We will provide a detailed user manual when it is released. Please pay attention. ## How to Use CloFab Now, let's see how to use it. There are three ways to open CloFab: 1. **Creating New Fabrics**: If you want to start creating new fabrics from the beginning, you can click on the CloFab icon at the top of the window fabric selection card. This will activate the CloFab window to create new fabrics. 2. **Modifying Existing Fabrics**: If you want to modify existing fabrics, click on the icon on the right side of the fabric project in the object window, then select from the list that appears the physical property you want to start with. 3. **Using the Main Menu**: You can also start CloFab from the main menu at the top. Click on the fabric menu, then click on the CloFab flag menu to begin creating new fabrics. To check the results directly on 3D clothing, use `Ctrl + A` to select all the versions and apply the newly added fabrics. The new fabric will be set as the default. You can simulate the synchronization first. ## Setting Up Fabrics At the top of the window, enter the name of the fabric. If necessary, you can also enter the supplier and all other relevant information. The top area is the preview area, currently providing user manuals and related information about the ZFabKit. In the middle, you can see it is mainly divided into physical property and physical property selection cards. The basic workflow is to create a physical property first, then start the project, and set the physical property. However, if you already have a sticker, you can directly enter the physical property selection card and only generate the physical property. You can also see the relevant introduction and link at the top. ## Creating Physical Properties Let's start with the physical property selection card. At the bottom of the physical property selection card, you can choose how to create a physical sticker. If you have the CloZFab scanning device, you can use the first option. To create a fabric sticker based on an image file you already have, even without a scanning device, you can import the file. If you follow the specified file naming rules, you can automatically add a PBR sticker to the same file. When opening the picture, it will first display the cut area. You can drag the screen to the center of the cut frame and adjust the cut area using the handles on the corners or sides. To move the position of the cut area, click and drag. If you want to redo the cut area, click the redo button in the upper right corner. After adjusting the cut area to keep the desired fabric portion, click the selection icon in the upper right corner or press the return button on the keyboard to complete the cut. After the cut is completed, you will enter the seamless processing step. ## Seamless Processing You need to find the repeat area in the fabric texture. Select the automatic option in the selection screen menu and choose the pattern type of the fabric. The system will display the best effect in the designated area in the top right corner of the screen. You can choose between two pattern types: - **Repeat Type**: Used for evenly repeating patterns (e.g., grid patterns). - **Single Color Irregular Type**: Used for fabrics with no specific pattern or irregular distribution. This type relies on line drawing information, so there must be a line drawing to achieve the correct result. For this fabric, I will choose the repeat type and drag to define the repeat area. The automatic analysis part will be displayed as a grid, allowing you to preview the repeat results based on the area. When selecting an area with four pattern repetitions, the automatic evaluation effect is the most accurate and efficient. You can view the seamless effect at the top and open the grid display to check the repeat unit. Click the switch menu icon on the left side to check the status of each picture. If the brightness of the result is not uniform, you can use the average function in the adjustment panel to correct it. ## Manual Adjustment of Repeat Area Next, let's see how to manually set the repeat area. To switch to manual mode, cancel the selection of automatic options in the setting panel or click the button in the lower right corner. In manual mode, you can directly adjust the selected area using the handles at the corners and edges. You can refresh the selection and then adjust as needed. After you are satisfied with the selection, click the hook button to confirm. The upper preview window will display the result of the manually selected area. Click "apply" to check the 3D clothing texture effect. ## Creating and Editing Physical Properties Next, click on the physical property option card to create a physical property. At the top, there is a button for the CloZFab fabric test device, which serves as a switch menu. If you have the CloZFab fabric test device, you can use it at any time. Even if you don't have one, you can easily create the right fabric for your clothing. All you need to do is enter the material and weight of the fabric type. First, select the fabric type; the component items will change according to the fabric type. Click on the sequence to choose. Next, enter the component information. First, select the fiber type and enter the content percentage of each item. Then, enter the weight and thickness of the fabric. In the preview at the top, you can see the actual 3D scroll effect based on the information you entered. The texture sticker created earlier will also be reflected in this preview. There will also be three pre-set texture pictures of the fabric type below. You can click to switch to use them or click again to switch back to the original texture. Click "apply" below to apply the physical property to 3D clothing. ## Finalizing Fabric Creation Open the simulation to check the body effect. Through the model type pull-down menu in the upper left corner, you can check the versatility of the fabric under various conditions. You can control the visual image in the preview window like in the 3D window, and you can lock the self-defined visual image by clicking the lock icon. Click the arrow next to the detailed information to directly edit the physical properties generated. Please remember that manually changing these values means you will change the result based on the original fabric information creation. In other words, the physical properties will no longer correspond to the input data, so be cautious when making adjustments. After the fabric creation is complete, you can use the bottom button to apply or save your work. If you want to save the fabric as a ZFAB file, click the save button in the lower left corner. In the preview image menu, you can choose which type of image to use as the preview of the fabric in the warehouse. By default, the fabric sticker image will be applied, but you can also add a self-defined image according to your needs. Select through the save function to choose which stickers and fabric files to save together. You can only choose and save the PBR sticker that can be used. After saving the sticker, click to confirm; the file resource manager window will appear. The fabric will be saved with the name you defined in CloFab. If it contains a sticker, it will automatically generate other file names based on the type of each sticker. Finally, if you click the new button, the content in each option card will reset to the initial state. ## Conclusion Now let's take a look through the library at the previously saved fabric and its PBR sticker. I hope you can use the new CloFab to create more efficient and high-quality digital fabrics. Thank you for watching! ```
